title: Eagle Sunrise Fan Panel Bed – Upholstered Bed Frame
descriptionHtml:
The Sunrise Fan Panel Bed is for anyone who wants a headboard with more movement than straight lines. It is built from radiating panels in a fan shape that catches the light differently depending on where you stand, and it is handmade to order in Dewsbury.

Key features

  • Fan-shaped radiating panel headboard
  • Solid timber frame for durability
  • Slatted base for mattress support and airflow
  • Optional ottoman gas-lift storage
  • Pairs well with warmer fabric tones such as Cream, Mink or Blush

Sizes and prices

Single (3FT) £311.99; Small Double (4FT) £324.99; Double (4FT6) £337.99; King (5FT) £349.99; Super King (6FT) £389.99. Not sure which size you need? See our bed sizes guide.

Materials & build

Solid timber frame with a slatted base for mattress support and airflow, handmade to order in our own workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire. Upholstered in Plush Velvet, Naples, Chenille, Linen or Crushed Velvet in a wide colour range, and free fabric swatches let you check colours at home.

Mattress

Takes a standard UK mattress in the size you choose. Browse our mattresses, such as the Memory Orthopaedic Mattress, to complete the bed.

Delivery, returns & warranty

Free delivery applies across Great Britain, by our own team, typically within 3-5 working days. Northern Ireland is £90. Changed your mind? You can return it free within 14 days if it is unused and unassembled in its original packaging, and we collect it. If anything arrives faulty we will replace it or refund you in full. Every bed has a 5-year frame warranty. Pay in instalments with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout. Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon-Fri, 9am-6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

Which panel bed?

The Sunrise Fan Panel Bed (this bed, from £311.99) has a fan-shaped headboard. If you prefer straight vertical panels, compare the Elegant Panel Bed, which has a shorter headboard (from £312.99), with the Regal Luxe Panel Bed, which has a mid-height headboard (from £312.99). Browse all panel beds.

Frequently asked questions

What does the Sunrise headboard look like?

It is built from radiating panels in a fan shape rather than straight lines.

Can I get ottoman storage?

Yes. Optional ottoman gas-lift storage is available. Call 07417 439197 to confirm the options.

How long does delivery take?

Delivery is free across Great Britain and usually takes 3-5 working days; Northern Ireland is £90.

Can I return it if it is not right?

Yes. Returns are free within 14 days if it is unused and unassembled in its original packaging, and faulty items are replaced or refunded in full.

Related: panel beds, ottoman beds.
